sources.title: Numerical Semigroups
sources.enterprise_use: Provides established numerical-semigroup language for finitely generated positive additive monoids after gcd normalization, including gaps, Apéry sets, Frobenius structure and conductors. P024 uses this prior mathematics to describe which translated observation boundaries remain unreachable under one-sided future action languages.
sources.not_claimed: Numerical semigroups, their gaps, Apéry sets, Frobenius numbers, conductors and eventual co-finiteness are established mathematics and are not Enterprise Math inventions.
